## Current objective
Continue invoice API pagination and report performance work. Vendor-credit CSV import and SQLAlchemy 2.0 migration are paused/superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Integration runner: `ci-runner-arm64`. `ci-runner-small` is superseded. Response: `InvoicePage(items,total,limit,offset)`. Relevant files: `ledgerly/api/invoices.py`, `ledgerly/services/invoices.py`, `ledgerly/schemas/invoice.py`, `tests/api/test_invoice_pagination.py`, `ledgerly/reports/invoice_summary.py`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Invoice index `(customer_id, created_at)` doubled ingest latency. Avoid nested invoice queries in reports; they cause N+1 behavior. No new Celery tasks until Locust reaches ≥400 successful executions/second with zero timeouts.

## Plan and progress
Pagination done: API/service/schema updated; 9 API tests, 3 pagination tests, and 18 billing tests pass. Ruff and `git diff --check` pass. Report investigation found repeated queries in `build_summary`; optimization pending. Next exact command: `rg -n "class Invoice|account_id|currency" ledgerly/models`

## Recent work
Measured `build_summary(tenant_id=73)`: 14,802 aggregates in 38.6 seconds. Report tests pass, but `test_large_tenant_summary` takes 12.84 seconds. Pagination changes remain uncommitted.
